title: Optimize vector candidate top-k sorting
rationale: VectorIndex::search scored HNSW candidates, fully sorted all scored candidates, and then truncated to k. A top-k partition keeps only the nearest requested candidates before final ordering, reducing sorting work when oversampling returns more candidates than k.
steps: Add a reusable vector distance comparator
Use select_nth_unstable_by to retain only the nearest k scored candidates
Sort only the retained top-k window before returning
Add unit coverage for limited vector search result ordering
expected_impact: Reduces vector search sorting work when HNSW oversampling returns more candidates than the requested result count.
